items.subject: Forward a short note to NTT Research?
items.body:
Hi Ryan,

Would you forward the blurb below to the relevant team at NTT Research? We co-authored a paper in December 2024 (as of 2024, you were at NTT Research and MIT's RLE), and I wonder if my nanophotonic work is relevant to them. No worries if you'd rather not.

Nicholas

Blurb you can forward:
Nicholas Harris, founder of Lightmatter, co-authored "Deep learning with coherent nanophotonic circuits" (2017). He co-authored a December 2024 paper with a researcher at NTT Research's Physics & Informatics Laboratories (as of 2024); might his work be relevant to your team?
